resolution: Built and served a browser Three.js demo for the compiled HMSC game data. The page loads the baked zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile by default, unwraps the platform gamefile to the map stream, decodes the RJMP scene, and renders it through an injected Three.js adapter with instanced meshes, heightfields, stats, and file/path loading controls. Started a local static server on 127.0.0.1:8765 for user review.
